text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, this is the worst...
How could I make such a mistake...?
choice_data_list: Did an experiment fail or something?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...No, if that's the case, then it's still fine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So in the dining hall, right...
Manhattan Cafe came and sat next to me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"That's fine and all, but... by mistake,
I ended up drinking her coffee."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It had the aroma and color of coffee...
So how on earth did I mix it up?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ugh, my mouth still tastes bitter...
